WHEREAS, THE CLERK FOR THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA, HAS PREPARED AND SUBMITTED TO THE GOVERNING AUTHORITY, A BUDGET PROPOSAL FOR THE FISCAL YEAR BEGINNING JULY 1, 2020 AND ENDING JUNE 30, 2021; AND

WHERAS, THE TOWN COUNCIL OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA HAS STUDIED AND REVISED THE PROPOSED BUDGET, AND DOES HEREBY CONSIDER IN THE BEST INTEREST OF THE TOWN OF CLERMONT TO APPROVE THE BUDGET AS PROPSOSED.

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE TOWN COUNCIL FOR THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA, DULY ASSEMBLED AND BY UNANIMOUS VOTE THEREOF, THAT THE BUDGET ATTACHED HERETO AND MADE A PART HEREOF FOR THE YEAR BEGINNING JULY 1, 2020 AND ENDING JUNE 30, 2021.

) James Nix, Mayor

Attest: Ae

Amy Lomax, Clerk

Date: 6/23/2020
